title: fix(console): the shared-record page shows a user field as "Linked user", never its sys_user id
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XS5vctb61zkww6CKydWkzsR)_

Fixes #31350

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：分享链接页 `/s/TOKEN` 上，有值的「用户」类型字段不再显示存储的 `sys_user` ID，改为显示本地化的中性占位「已关联用户」/ "Linked user"；空值仍显示为空。判断依据是 resolve 应答 `fields` 投影里已下发的 `type: 'user'`，与查找字段（#31326）走同一个引用类型集合，不另开代码路径。
- 为什么改：匿名访客看到一串内部用户 ID，既无用又像页面坏了；与 #31326 同一类展示缺陷。显示用户姓名属于 #27200 选项 B 的安全边界问题，本 PR 不碰。
- 风险与回滚：只改 console 一页的展示层，外加 `@object-ui/i18n` 每个语言包一个新键 `sharedRecord.linkedUser`；不改 resolve 接口、不改服务端、不多发请求、不读 `sys_user`。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`ui/apps/console/src/pages/SharedRecordFields.tsx`（`RECORD_REFERENCE_TYPES` 加入 `user`，`referencePlaceholder` 按类型选占位文案）、`SharedRecordPage-27121.test.tsx` 末尾新增的 `objectstack#31350` describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/SharedRecordPage-27121.test.tsx`，预期 18 个用例全绿，其中用户字段三例断言整个 DOM 里找不到 `sys_user` ID。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`SharedRecordFields.tsx`** (`@object-ui/console`): `user` joins `lookup` and `master_detail` in `RECORD_REFERENCE_TYPES`, the one reference-type set #31326 added, so a user row takes the same branch: a filled one (an id, or a non-empty array of ids for a multiple user field) renders a neutral placeholder in the muted foreground, and an empty one (null, undefined, empty string, empty array) renders the page's existing empty face. A new `referencePlaceholder` picks the wording by the projected type: `t('sharedRecord.linkedUser')` for `user`, `t('sharedRecord.linkedRecord')` otherwise. The decision reads the `type` the resolve answer's `fields` projection already serves, never the value's shape, and nothing reads the user record. The module header and the set's doc comment now name user fields.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`**: every built-in pack gains `sharedRecord.linkedUser` (en "Linked user", zh-Hans 「已关联用户」, the other nine translated). `zh-Hant.ts` was produced by `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n gen:zh-hant` (「已關聯使用者」).
- **Changeset** `.changeset/31350-shared-user-placeholder.md`: `@object-ui/console` and `@object-ui/i18n` patch, with both declaration lines.
- Not changed: `GET /api/v1/share-links/TOKEN/resolve`, `packages/types/src/share-link-resolve-answer.ts`, and any server code. No read of `sys_user`.

## Tests

- `SharedRecordPage-27121.test.tsx`, the page's existing harness, rendered through the real route with the resolve answer stubbed the way both producers send it. New top-level describe for objectstack#31350 (5 cases), fed a `ticket` answer:
  - a filled user field reads "Linked user", its id is absent from `document.body.innerHTML`, and the only request is the resolve one;
  - a multiple user field reads "Linked user" and none of its ids is in the DOM;
  - an empty user field (null) and an empty multiple one (`[]`) render the empty face;
  - under a zh `I18nProvider` the placeholder is the zh-Hans pack's value (guarded as a real zh row);
  - CONTROL: text fields render their values as before, and a lookup in the same record still reads "Linked record".
- Ablation on head `7e62d74b` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: `user` dropped from `RECORD_REFERENCE_TYPES` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `83ad4488` to `f3f23dcc`). Result: 3 of 18 red (filled, multiple, zh); the empty-field case and the control stay green, as expected, since an empty user value and a text value render the same either way. Restored: blob equal to HEAD (`83ad4488`) and `git diff HEAD` empty. The console tests import `SharedRecordFields.tsx` from source by relative path, so no build sat between the mutation and the run.

## Acceptance notes

- **Measured before the first edit: the projection serves `type: 'user'`.** On `origin/main` (`dc7f5c4b`), a throwaway probe (not committed, deleted) registered an object on a real `ObjectQL` over `@objectstack/driver-sql` + better-sqlite3 and ran `projectSharedRecordFields(engine.getSchema(...), record, [])` from `@objectstack/types` dist. A declared user field projected `{"label":"Sales Rep","type":"user","reference":"sys_user"}`; a multiple one added `"multiple":true`. The registry-injected `owner_id`, `created_by` and `updated_by` project as `type: 'lookup'` and were already covered by #31326.
- **Why a new key rather than reusing `sharedRecord.linkedRecord`.** "Linked record" under a person's label (for example "Assigned To") names a person as a record, in every pack; one key was added, as the order allows. The ui seat agreed before the edit.
- **Declaration lines.** The claim opened at `Clause-②: no`; adding an `@object-ui/i18n` key is published surface, so this PR and its changeset declare `yes (widening)`. `Metadata-protocol: none`: nothing a metadata author writes changes.
- **An older server.** An answer without `fields` carries no `type`, so a user field there still shows its id, as before; guessing from the value's shape is ruled out.
- Showing the person's name stays with option B on #27200.
